mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(total_amount),0) as totalRevenue from team_payment where payment_status = 'DONE'
select floor(ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) * 0.08) as totalProfitTeam from team_payment where payment_status = 'DONE'
select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as month_revenue from team_payment where payment_status = 'DONE' and year(approved_at) = year(curdate()) and month(approved_at) = month(curdate())
select floor(ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) * 0.08) as month_revenue from team_payment where payment_status = 'DONE' and year(approved_at) = year(curdate()) and month(approved_at) = month(curdate())

select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as month_revenue from team_payment where payment_status = 'DONE' and approved_at >= date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01') - interval #{n} month and approved_at < date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01') - interval #{n} month + Interval 1 month

select floor(ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0)*0.08) as month_revenue from team_payment where payment_status = 'DONE' and approved_at >= date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01') - interval #{n} month and approved_at < date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01') - interval #{n} month + Interval 1 month
select count(*) as period_cnt from team_payment where payment_status = 'DONE' and approved_at >= #{startDate} and approved_at < #{endDate} + interval 1 day
select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as month_revenue from team_payment where payment_status = 'DONE' and approved_at >= #{startDate} and approved_at < #{endDate} + interval 1 day
select floor(ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0)*0.08) as month_revenue from team_payment where payment_status = 'DONE' and approved_at >= #{startDate} and approved_at < #{endDate} + interval 1 day
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_payment ( order_id, payment_key, order_name, payment_status, payment_method, total_amount, balance, currency, card_company, card_number, installment_months, easy_payment_provider, receipt_url, requested_at, approved_at, raw_response ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{paymentKey}, #{orderName}, #{paymentStatus}, #{paymentMethod}, #{totalAmount}, #{balance}, #{currency}, #{cardCompany}, #{cardNumber}, #{installmentMonths}, #{easyPaymentProvider}, #{receiptUrl}, #{requestedAt}, #{approvedAt}, #{rawResponse} )
mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM team_payment tp JOIN team_match_participant p ON p.payment_id = tp.payment_id JOIN team_match m ON m.team_match_id = p.team_match_id WHERE tp.payment_key = #{paymentKey}
mapper.insert: insert into team_match_participant ( user_id, team_match_id, team_id, status, payment_id, attendance, applied_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{matchId}, #{teamId}, '결제완료', #{paymentId}, 0, now())
mapper.select: select count(*) from team_match_participant where team_match_id = #{matchId} and status = '결제완료' and team_id in (select team_id from team_user where user_id = #{userId} and team_role in ('CAPTAIN', 'VICE_CAPTAIN') and withdrawn = 0)
mapper.update: update team_payment set payment_status = 'CANCELED', balance = 0, canceled_at = #{canceledAt}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, cancel_amount = #{cancelAmount} where payment_id = #{paymentId}
mapper.select: select pay.payment_id, pay.payment_key, pay.total_amount, p.user_id, m.title from team_match m join team_match_participant p on p.team_match_id = m.team_match_id and p.team_id = m.team_id join team_payment pay on pay.payment_id = p.payment_id where m.team_match_id = #{matchId} and p.status = '결제완료' and pay.payment_status = 'DONE'
